title: [Bug]: [DE] XRechnung/ZUGFeRD - Item Charge lines exported without a valid unit of measure code (BR-CL-23 / BR-23 on BT-130)
summary: Item charge lines are now correctly exported as allowances or charges in XRechnung and ZUGFeRD documents instead of fabricated invoice lines, with configurable mapping strategies to comply with EN 16931 validation rules.
key_points: New Item Charge E-Invoice Mapping setting on E-Document Service: Automatic, document-level or line-level allowance/charge, or line with unit code
Per-item-charge override for mapping, reason text, reason code and fallback unit code
Automatic mode uses Value Entry assignments to choose line-level or document-level, with integration events to override the result
XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exporters emit allowance/charge structures and adjust totals and tax subtotals accordingly
Removes a duplicate features key that stopped the DE demo data app from compiling
